_doc: survey_map.py settings (v3_marker 2026-10-31). Everything the map builder assumes about the vehicle and the room lives here, so a different vehicle / sensor / site only needs a new file. Frames: body FLU (x fwd, y left, z up, m); map = rack design frame (qvix_grid model frame: x across the aisles, y along, z above the floor). Defaults = Starling 2 M0054 (cameras_2026-10-30.zip).

tag_camera._doc: tag_detections t_cam = [right, down, forward] of the tag centre in the (undistorted) camera. pos = camera centre in body FLU (extrinsics.conf tracking_front: FRD 0.0665,-0.0065,-0.0154). sd = sd0 + sd_k * range per axis, down axis x down_mult (vehicle pitch/roll is not modelled).

tof._doc: depth image along the optical axis, pinhole hfov over the image width, square pixels. pos/rpy = sensor in body FLU (rpy deg, x fwd optical). Real Starling 2: FRD 0.066,0.009,-0.012 (= FLU 0.066,-0.009,0.012; the SIM sensor sits at x 0.080, outside the CAD body mesh - set 0.066 for the real vehicle); the wide 106.5 deg axis is vertical (to confirm). Plane fits (sense.csv: d body->face, alpha) use d_sd / alpha_sd per frame, inflated by frame_corr for correlated frames.
tof._edge: EXPERIMENTAL, off: tray edges in the central ToF column as the height reference (edge_hz 2 = on). 2026-10-31 upper-tag z rms sv3 2.55 -> 1.64 cm but sv1 0.74 -> 1.30, sv5 0.73 -> 1.75 cm

vio._doc: VIO/PX4 local position errors on knots every knot_s. drift_model velocity: the drift is a slowly changing velocity (random walk q_vel m/s/sqrt s, first-segment velocity sd vel0_sd) - an in-place turn cannot move the map; position: random walk q_pos (m/sqrt s). heading wander q_yaw (deg/sqrt s, EKF2_EV_CTRL 7). Start prior: set down within start_sd of the plan's start cell, heading from the online estimator.

map_prior._doc: how far the real room may differ from the design. Tags: placed on the post of the design spot; offsets along the face (y), up/down (z), stand-off from the face. Faces: offset and turn of each rack face line. Walls: offset only.
map_prior._anchor: walls: after the solve, shift the whole map so the room walls (x: W/E mean, y: S/N mean) sit on the design; none: frame from the priors only

filters._doc: measurements taken while turning faster than this or lower than min_height above the take-off point are not used (timing, floor in view)
